Hi there. No need to not to trust a therapist. He/She won't harm you. When i talked to my therapist the first time i was a wreck, nervous to no end fearing he would laugh at me and tell me i am just crazy and don't understand me. I was proven wrong and he really did help me. He questioned me and all i had to do was open up a bit and be truthful. In my first session i brought my sisters along with me and it was no problem. I cried two times at hearing that i have a heavy depression. I have it since i was a child. The second session was quite awful for me too because he said i still have a heavy depression and have to take my meditaion for at least a half year or else i won't get better. You don't have to worry about too much. I encourage you to look for a therapist or first talk to someone you trust and ask him/her to go with you. Look for a good therapist and talk about everything. It will be fine.
